question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Count the named exports in the PE export directory. Submit the count in base 10.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

generator_cmd: python3 -m ziglang cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu -O1 -shared -o gf_pe_exports.dll gf_exports.c
oracle_cmd: objdump -p gf_pe_exports.dll | sed -n '/\[Ordinal\/Name Pointer\] Table/,/^$/p' | awk '/\+base/{print $NF}' | wc -l
